text:
Asha (Product): quick question from legal: people keep asking where the "region" widget lives. Should we surface 'Region' and 'Key owner' as persistent chrome near the top-right, or keep them grouped inside the Data protection card? mock: https://rwd.example/s/cons-console-v2 :eyes:
Liam (Design): putting region up top makes residency discoverable on all pages, but it competes with account-level badges. If we place key owner next to retention it keeps the context of lifecycle controls.
Diego (Eng): visibility note: making 'Key owner' global means we fetch key metadata on page load for most routes. That increases calls and has cache implications. We can lazy-load but there are flicker concerns.
Maya (A11y): accessibility tradeoff: if it's part of header the reading order changes and screen readers may lose the connection to retention controls. We should add an aria-labelledby that ties the header pill to the Data protection heading.
Asha (Product): what if we show a compact region pill in header (Region: US-West) and have a concise row in the Data protection card: "Encryption / Key: Managed (AcmeCorp) — Manage"? keeps both global discoverability and context.
Liam (Design): I can try that. For the pill copy I propose: "Region • US‑West (data residency)" hover: "Primary storage region for this account". For the key: small inline label "Managed key — AcmeCorp" with a chevron to Manage.
Diego (Eng): copy note: backend returns retention_seconds or null. Frontend currently shows "Default: 30d" when null. We should avoid jargon: propose tooltip "Default retention: 30 days (account policy may override)" and if account-level policy applies show a link "View policy".
Maya (A11y): tooltip must be keyboard-focusable and not only hover. Use button role, aria-expanded on help popover, and ensure focus trap if modal. Also any change to encryption should be announced: aria-live="polite" text like "Encryption method updated to Managed key".
Asha (Product): agreed on copy. Also audit log timestamps came up in support — they want local timezone + an explicit UTC badge. How should we display row copy?
Liam (Design): suggestion for narrow rows: "2025‑07‑02 09:12 PDT — Key rotated by alice@acme.com" with smaller secondary text for timezone and a hover tooltip showing UTC: "2025‑07‑02 16:12 UTC".
Diego (Eng): doable. Implementation detail: the log export currently outputs timestamps in UTC only. Product asks the exported CSV to include both local and UTC columns. That affects CSV column headings. Current heading is "timestamp"; proposal: change to "timestamp_local, timestamp_utc" or at least document that the export is in local TZ.
Asha (Product): I think team prefers CSV with both columns and an export button label that clearly says what it includes. Current label "Export" is ambiguous. Proposal: "Download audit CSV (local + UTC)" or shorter "Download audit CSV" with inline helper "includes both local and UTC timestamps". preference: shorter button + helper.
Maya (A11y): export dialog must announce file type and column schema when opened, and keyboard focus should land on the download button. Screen readers should be able to read column names before download.
Diego (Eng): I'll add backend ticket: RW-4120 add UTC column to audit export; RW-4121 frontend: show region pill + inline key owner + accessible tooltips; RW-4122 a11y: aria-live + popover focus. I'll link test cases.
Asha (Product): final approved microcopy: region pill hover -> "Primary storage region for this account"; retention tooltip -> "Default retention: 30 days (account policy may override)"; export helper -> "CSV includes local and UTC timestamps".
Liam (Design): I'll push updated mock with narrow breakpoint and the new pill/inline layout.
Maya (A11y): I'll add an a11y checklist to the ticket with screen-reader strings and keyboard tests.
Diego (Eng): tagging ops-bot for planned deploy: ops-bot, can we schedule a config-only deploy for copy/CSV change next week? :slightly_smiling_face:
ops-bot: planned maintenance window: 2025-07-08 03:00 UTC — copy + export changes (non-breaking).
Asha (Product): thanks everyone — I'll update the console style guide and docs with the new CSV schema note and add a KB article about "How timestamps are shown in exports". :memo:
